results.title: The Case for Learned Index Structures
results.snippet: Indexes are models: a B-tree maps a key to a position within a sorted array, and a learned model can approximate that same mapping with far less space.

results.title: The Case for Learned Index Structures (preprint)
results.snippet: We show that learned indexes can outperform cache-optimized B-trees by up to 70% in speed while saving an order of magnitude in memory on several real-world datasets.

results.title: RadixSpline: A Single-Pass Learned Index
results.snippet: A learned index that is built in a single pass over sorted data, with no hyperparameter tuning, while matching the lookup performance of existing learned structures.
